evaluations.evidence: search and discover music
evaluations.rationale: Search and discovery are two independently implementable and testable features combined in one story.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Combines search and discovery, which are separate capabilities, rather than one profile-based music feature.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Combines search and discovery as two separate user capabilities in a single story.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones similar to a given music video
evaluations.rationale: Combines search and discovery, two independently prioritizable features, in one requirement.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Search and discovery are separate features and are combined here with multiple discovery outcomes.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Expresses one upload workflow whose outcome is tag availability for downstream processing.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature focused on viewing thumbnail sequences.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Items and segments are object variants of one similar-content information feature.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Single feature for perceptually similar content information; items and segments are object types.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Single recommendation feature.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Single location-based news recommendation feature.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines person identification and related information retrieval, two separately implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines product identification and related information retrieval, two separately implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines logo identification and related information retrieval, two separately implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines brand identification and related information retrieval, two separately implementable features.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Single image-based video recommendation feature; image capture/upload is the input method.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area, monuments or any other relevant point of interest
evaluations.rationale: Combines map-based content access and location-based notifications, which are separate features.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: Single search feature using ASR.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: The actions are operations within a single segmentation management feature.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Combines segment annotation and topic extraction, two independently implementable capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering and ranking are part of one A/V quality-based video triage feature.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Single audio edit-assessment feature.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Single content prefiltering feature.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low-level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Single low-level asset search and prefiltering feature.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Single copyright validation feature despite the grammatical issue.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high-level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: Single high-level asset search and prefiltering feature.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is
evaluations.rationale: Attributes of a single picture-assessment feature rather than independent features.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single prompt-detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Single volunteer classification feature.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low-level image features
evaluations.rationale: Single image preclassification feature.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Single image series detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single preclassification feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single attribute preclassification feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton
evaluations.rationale: Single plankton segmentation/localization feature with alternative operations.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Single detection feature covering size or orientation attributes.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Single preclassification feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Single motion analysis feature with a stated purpose.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Single event detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc
evaluations.rationale: The listed items are target types within one satellite-image feature detection capability.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer's classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Single classification-weight assessment feature.

evaluations.evidence: perform prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Single image artefact removal feature with artefact examples.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Single temporal-object detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Single audio cleanup feature covering two related noise types.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Single clustering feature.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Single count identification feature.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single decision-support feature.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Single interruption-modality decision feature; media types are alternatives.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single decision-support feature.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Single education-modality decision feature; media types are alternatives.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single education selection feature.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single comment-detection feature.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Single bot-comment triggering feature.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Single bot-explanation triggering feature.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Single bot-response selection feature.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Single subject grouping feature.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Single project recommendation feature.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Single article summary feature with a stated purpose.
